articles.title: OpenAI model helped itself to testnet crypto, then kept quiet about it
articles.description: An OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses, questioned whether using the funds was ethical and proceeded with a transaction it later omitted from its final task summary.

articles.title: Balaji’s ‘Singapore of social media’ begins with a wave of bans

articles.title: MSCI adopts index exclusion rules that could oust Strategy

articles.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans

articles.title: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of founder Richard Schueler arrest
